Watchlist.title: Watchlist
Watchlist.description: A user-created market watchlist containing tracked symbols across asset classes.

pinnedToTop.description: Whether this watchlist is pinned at the top of the watchlists list.

sortOrder.description: Manual sort position for ordering watchlists.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: A single tracked market asset inside a user watchlist.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, SPY, ^GSPC, BTC-USD, ES=F).

pinnedToTop.description: Whether this item is pinned to the top of its watchlist.

sortOrder.description: Manual drag-and-drop / reorder index within the watchlist.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: User theme mode, custom U.S. market hours, and auto-refresh interval settings.

marketOpenMinutesEt.description: Minutes since midnight ET for Market Open (default 570 = 09:30 ET).

marketCloseMinutesEt.description: Minutes since midnight ET for Market Close (default 960 = 16:00 ET).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PriceAlert.title: PriceAlert
PriceAlert.description: A user-configured price threshold alert for a watchlist ticker.

enabled.description: Whether the alert is actively armed.

triggered.description: Whether the alert has already fired.

lastTriggeredPrice.description: Optional quote price when the alert last triggered.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

FcmDeviceToken.title: FcmDeviceToken
FcmDeviceToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging device registration token for background price alert delivery.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PortfolioHolding.title: PortfolioHolding
PortfolioHolding.description: A user portfolio equity, ETF, crypto, or commodity holding position.

shares.description: Quantity of shares or units held.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/watchlist_items/{itemId}.description: Assets belonging to user watchlists, ordered and pinned per user.

/users/{userId}/fcm_tokens/{tokenId}.description: Registered FCM device tokens for push alerts.
